visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman appears in a bright, modern indoor clinic lobby wearing a large, plush green Christmas tree costume decorated with shiny tinsel and red baubles. She wears a yellow star on her head and dances playfully with high energy, performing high kicks and hand gestures. The lighting is warm and professional, highlighting the wooden wall panels and a glass door in the background. (2) The woman transitions to casual attire, wearing a maroon sweatshirt and black shorts. She stands next to a massive cardboard shipping container in the same clinic lobby. She gestures toward the box with wide arm movements and then slides the front panel open to reveal a sleek medical device wrapped in protective plastic. A large poster featuring a woman's face is visible on the right. (3) The scene shifts to a montage of still photos and short clips showing the woman's midriff. She pulls up her shirt to reveal her stomach area in a domestic bedroom setting with a mirror. Then, a quick transition shows her standing outside on a street in casual wear holding a shopping bag. (4) The camera focuses on a close-up of a high-tech medical machine called 'Onda Pro'. It features a large touchscreen interface and vertical blue LED light strips on its sides. A hand holds a medical certificate or permit in front of the machine for verification. (5) Close-up shots of the woman's face follow. She is lying down, and the skin on her cheeks and jawline appears slightly flushed. She uses her fingers to touch and point at her jawline, demonstrating firmness. (6) The video returns to the woman in the Christmas tree costume. She stands in the clinic lobby, pointing toward the camera and then toward a floating text overlay that provides social media contact information. She maintains an expressive and cheerful facial expression throughout.
